content: Older adults residing in long-term care (LTC) facilities often exhibit irregular eating patterns, which can significantly increase their risk of hypoglycemia. Developing individualized meal plans tailored to their specific needs and preferences can aid in managing diabetes effectively while ensuring they receive adequate nutritional intake. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems may serve as a valuable tool for detecting and managing hypoglycemia in LTC settings, particularly where conducting formal evaluations may be difficult or impractical.
